title: Three Weeks and One Short Bottle
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：medicine　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 medicine 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the doctor ① took the medicine that no patient in the infirmary would have recorded, and he said the taking was the whole of the week. The ② medicine, meaning the drug itself and not the bottle, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; medicine, he said, is the only thing in an infirmary that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ dose of medicine in that infirmary had the same short bottle beside it, and the ④ medicine at the far cupboard, meaning the spoon they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Medicine, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the doctor said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the medicine was the whole of the matter, meaning the cure and not the drug. The ⑥ medicine, meaning the cure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; medicine, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both drug and a cure. He said the cure is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ medicine had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short bottle. The ⑧ medicine of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in April, was one infirmary and three weeks of recording; medicine, he said, is either the spoon at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ medicine I remember is the medicine recorded in the chart, which closed in 1980 and is still recorded as the quietest in the infirmary. ⑩ Medicine, my mother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all medicine, she said, is a cure that has agreed to look like drug. She said the cure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 药；药物（指医务室里每一剂旁边的那一剂）
B. n. 药；药物（指那瓶药本身，与药瓶相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the medicine 服用这瓶药
D. n. 药；药物（指留给孩子们服的那一匙那一瓶）
E. n. 用药之事（抽象总称，指一处医务室的药之事）
F. n. 药；药物（指用药记录里写到、被记载的的那一瓶）
G. n. 疗效、调理（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 调理（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the medicine that no patient in the infirmary would have recorded
The medicine, meaning the drug itself and not the bottle
Every dose of medicine in that infirmary
the medicine at the far cupboard
the medicine was the whole of the matter
the medicine had become a line in a chart
The medicine of the whole thing

answers.why: take the medicine 意为“服用这瓶药”，1973 年那位大夫把医务室里没有一位病人肯记载的一瓶药做了一遍。
medicine 意为“药；药物”，指那瓶药本身而不是药瓶，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
medicine 意为“药；药物”，指医务室里每一剂旁边的那一剂，每一剂旁边都有同一只小小的药瓶。
medicine 意为“药；药物”，指最远那格药柜留给孩子们服的那一匙那一瓶，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
medicine 意为“疗效、调理”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份疗效就是那件事的全部。
medicine 意为“调理”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那瓶药，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
medicine 意为“药；药物”，指用药记录里写到、被记载的的那一瓶，到 1978 年这一瓶成了用药记录里的一行。
medicine 意为“用药之事”，大夫四月写道，整件事的药之事是一处医务室和三个星期的记载。
medicine 意为“药；药物”，我记得的是用药记录里记载过的那一瓶，1980 年用完了，至今仍被说成医务室里最安静的一瓶。
medicine 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，药是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的药。

叔叔说这份疗效就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那瓶药。（medicine）
